mentions.name: PhotoWeather
mentions.description: PhotoWeather is a weather-based app that tells photographers when and where they could be photographing, surfacing photographic opportunities from weather forecasts so users get out with their camera more often.
mentions.problem: The author never has time to look at weather forecasts, and since outdoor photography depends heavily on weather, they don't get out with their camera enough.
mentions.audience: Photographers who do weather-dependent outdoor photography and lack time to check forecasts; the author personally uses it all the time.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building https://photoweather.app because I never end up having time to look at weather forecasts, which means I also don't go out with my camera enough since outdoor photography is quite a weather dependent activity.. so I'm trying to turn this around by having the app tell me when and where I could be photographing instead.
